user.title: Hisense E7N Pro
user.description: The TV must be on. Keys use the TV's own MQTT on port 36669. You do not need a Bluetooth MAC. Wi-Fi MAC is only for Wake-on-LAN.

data_description.host: IPv4 of the E7N Pro. Give it a DHCP reservation.
data_description.mac: Optional. Wi-Fi MAC for Wake-on-LAN only. It is not the remote identity, and it is not a Bluetooth address.
data_description.auth_mode: auto tries modern VIDAA credentials first, then legacy static login.
data_description.client_cert: Leave empty to use a generated stand-in cert. If MQTT rc=5, extract the VIDAA/爱家 client cert (see docs).

power_on.title: Power on
power_on.description: 爱家 cannot start a fully off TV. Pick this set's wake method.

data_description.power_on_mode: Button presses a button, switch, or script. Infrared remote calls remote.send_command. Wake-on-LAN uses the Wi-Fi MAC.
data_description.power_on_button: Used when power on is Button.
data_description.power_on_command: Command name stored on that remote, for example power.
data_description.power_on_device: Optional device name, only for remotes that need it (Harmony).

volume.title: Volume buttons
volume.description: Optional Home Assistant entities that replace LAN KEY_VOLUME* for media_player volume +/-.

data_description.volume_up_button: Optional. Volume up presses this button/switch/script instead of the TV LAN key.
data_description.volume_down_button: Optional. Volume down presses this button/switch/script instead of the TV LAN key.
data_description.音量加按钮: 可选。填写后，媒体播放器音量加会按下这个按钮/开关/脚本，不再发电视 LAN 键。
data_description.音量减按钮: 可选。填写后，媒体播放器音量减会按下这个按钮/开关/脚本，不再发电视 LAN 键。

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the TV MQTT port (default 36669). Confirm the TV is fully on (not standby), the IP is the TV's LAN address, Home Assistant is on the same network, and phone remote / network control is enabled.
error.timeout: The TV accepted TCP on 36669 but did not complete MQTT. Wait until the TV has finished booting, then try again.
error.tls_failed: Reached port 36669 but the TLS handshake failed. Retry after a TV reboot. If it still fails, keep auth mode on auto.
error.not_authorized: MQTT connected but the TV rejected the login (rc=5). Keep auth mode on auto, set the TV clock/timezone correctly, and retry.
error.power_on_required: This power-on method needs the matching entity, IR command, or Wi-Fi MAC.
error.volume_button_invalid: Pick a button, switch, or script entity.

abort.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the TV.
